subject.title: feat(github-copilot): add native web search for Copilot GPT models

question: Should claim-qualified, allowlisted GitHub Copilot Responses models automatically use native web search for unset, `auto`, or `openai` provider selection?
rationale: Code and live proof establish safe mechanics, but the upgrade default, explicit-provider semantics, and long-term ownership of an auth-derived model allowlist require maintainer intent.

options.title: Approve current guarded routing
options.body: Treat unset, `auto`, and `openai` as native-capable for qualified Copilot models while preserving every other managed, disabled, unknown-model, and missing-claim path.

options.title: Narrow explicit-provider handling
options.body: Enable native search only for unset or `auto`, leaving an explicit `openai` selection on its established routing semantics.

options.title: Require explicit native opt-in
options.body: Preserve managed search for upgrades and add a deliberate Copilot-native selection path.

recommendation.title: Approve current guarded routing
recommendation.body: Treat unset, `auto`, and `openai` as native-capable for qualified Copilot models while preserving every other managed, disabled, unknown-model, and missing-claim path.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the current Copilot provider wrapper and catalog boundary that owns this routing behavior.
